name: Nishizono-ke no Kakushigoto
source:
Nishizono-ke no Kakushigoto follows a scumbag. When his sex friend leaves, he's irritated... until he meets Sayuki, who lives with her daughter. He deceives her and installs hidden cameras in their home. Happy life starts to fall apart, but what awaits at the end of such a path?

[From [url=https://x.com/ErogeAreAlive/status/2075519732195659957]Visual Novel News[/url]]
